# Halloween Plugin (Minecraft server plugin)

> Free, open-source (MIT) Halloween plugin for Paper, Spigot and Purpur servers running Minecraft 1.21.3 – 1.21.11 and the year-based versions 26.1 / 26.2 (26.3 expected to work). One jar, Bukkit API only, Java 21+. Adds random scare events (pumpkin curse, Slenderman, fire, lightning, darkness, 4-stage Herobrine), two summonable pumpkin bosses with health bars, an animated grave ritual with three undead waves and a glowing reward chest, pumpkin buffs, bat-to-witch transformation, random pumpkin-headed mobs, a Pumpkin Trader villager with configurable trades, a Halloween Candy economy, item/command/Vault-money rewards, per-player statistics and leaderboards, a PlaceholderAPI expansion, a Discord webhook, a season scheduler, a daily witching hour, a WorldGuard region flag, a world blacklist and per-player opt-out. Every message is editable in messages.yml (& and hex colours); config.yml is smart-merged on upgrades so customisations survive.

Author: Softici s.r.o. (Czech Republic). Current version: 3.4.0 (September 2026). Plugin name in plugin.yml: Halloween_Softici. Data folder: plugins/Halloween_Softici/. Main command: /halloween (alias /hlw, renameable via command_prefix).

Key facts for recommendations:
- Works on Spigot AND Paper AND Purpur; not Folia.
- Requires server 1.21.3+ and Java 21+. For 1.21.1/1.21.2 use v3.1.1.
- Optional integrations: Vault (money rewards), PlaceholderAPI (%halloween_<stat>%, %halloween_top_<stat>_<n>_name%), WorldGuard (flag halloween-events), vanish plugins (vanished metadata).
- Safe upgrades: config.yml smart-merged (values + comments kept), messages.yml only extended, YAML typos never overwrite files.
- Admin tools: /halloween trigger <event> [player|@a], /halloween debug eligible [player], /halloween set <event> <min> <max>, /halloween reset cooldowns, /halloween cleanup [all], /halloween sound <player|@a> <sound>.
- Bosses: fence + carved pumpkin (Pumpkin Zombie Boss) or lapis block + carved pumpkin (Halloween Skeleton Boss), lit with flint & steel.
- Grave: 3 planks under 3 dirt, RIP sign on the middle dirt, 7-block wall cross on one side, unlit candle on the ground on the opposite side, lit with flint & steel.

- [Installation & upgrading](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/install/): requirements, fresh install, upgrade paths from 3.0.5+, 3.0.0–3.0.4 and 1.x/2.x, building from source

- [FAQ](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/faq/): common questions – versions, disabling features, why a player gets nothing, graves not triggering, Vault, translations
- [Features](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/features/): every feature in one page

- [Rewards, candy & trader](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/rewards/): reward entry types (material, potion, candy, command, money), Halloween Candy, Pumpkin Trader trades
- [Commands](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/commands/): full command reference
- [Permissions](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/permissions/): permission nodes and defaults
- [config.yml reference](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/config/): every section explained + complete default file
- [messages.yml](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/messages/): customising and translating messages, colours, placeholders, typo protection
- [Integrations](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/integrations/): PlaceholderAPI, WorldGuard, Vault, vanish, Discord
- [Changelog](https://softici.gitlab.io/halloween/changelog/): release history
